business_summary: SFL Corp Ltd. (NYSE: SFL) is a diversified maritime asset owner leasing a mixed fleet of tankers, dry bulk, container and offshore vessels on long-term and spot charters; five Suezmax crude tankers in its fleet list give it a real, if partial and diluted, expression of Gulf-transit tanker economics.

exposure_summary.narrative: SFL sits on the crude-tanker-tonnage link (OVER_CROWDED, money_corner False), but only five of its diversified fleet are Suezmax crude tankers; the balance of the fleet is dry bulk, container and offshore assets with no cited Hormuz linkage. FY2025 companyfacts shows revenue of $733.0M, an operating margin of 18.6% (thinner than the pure-play tanker owners on this link, consistent with a diversified charter book) and a net loss year (-$26.4M net income against positive operating cash flow of $267.1M), which produces a large negative operating-cash-flow-to-net-income ratio worth reading as a non-cash-charge year rather than an operating cash problem.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No Suezmax-crude-tanker-segment revenue percentage is broken out in companyfacts; SFL's fleet list evidences five relevant vessels out of a much larger diversified fleet, but no filing splits segment revenue that finely.
